p8_b3.ocr: This variation in sample size is essential for understanding the representativeness of the findings. The table illustrates not only the count of responses per variable but also the corresponding percentages, which highlight the relative frequency of each answer across the groups. Notably, the Chi-square metric included in the table serves as a statistical tool to assess the significance of differences observed among the groups, indicating whether the variations in responses are likely due to chance or reflect genuine differences in opinion or behavior.
